community.description: SNMP community string (prefer a secure, non-default value in production)

location.description: Physical location of the FTP server (used in sysLocation MIB)

contact.description: Contact information for the server administrator (sysContact MIB)

log_level.description: SNMP daemon log verbosity (0–7; higher = more verbose)

trap_events.description: List of events that trigger SNMP traps; common values: login, logout, upload, download, rename, delete

items.description: Event name to enable as a trap trigger

trap_destinations.description: List of SNMP trap receiver hosts

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SNMP manager

community.description: Community string to use when sending traps to this destination (optional; defaults to SNMPCommunity if omitted)

pid_file.description: Path to the SNMP sub-daemon PID file

allowed_hosts.description: List of hosts allowed to query SNMP (e.g., SNMP set/get requests); each item is a host spec (hostname, IP, or CIDR)

items.description: Allowed host IP, hostname, or CIDR notation
